metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: terminal mods (readable replies, a working band, prompt cards) and version-pinned documentation skills for VFX and pipeline software.

plugins.name: pretty-markdown
plugins.description: Bordered code blocks with copy and fold, inline-code chips, coloured diffs, tables, headings, callouts and a Next: box.

plugins.name: working-band
plugins.description: A live line above the prompt while Claude works, tidier tool rows, and a turn footer with tool and file counts.

plugins.name: prompt-cards
plugins.description: Your prompts as blue cards, dimmed while queued, and /prompts to jump to any one.

plugins.name: openusd-26-11
plugins.description: OpenUSD 26.11 docs and the USD Survival Guide, mirrored locally as searchable Markdown.

plugins.name: unreal-5-8
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5.8 documentation, mirrored locally as searchable Markdown.

plugins.name: rez-3-4
plugins.description: rez 3.4 documentation (guide, CLI and Python API), mirrored locally as searchable Markdown.

plugins.name: deadline-10-4
plugins.description: Deadline 10.4 User Manual, Scripting Reference and Standalone Python Reference, mirrored locally as searchable Markdown.

plugins.name: blender-5-2
plugins.description: Blender 5.2 LTS manual, Python API and developer docs, mirrored locally as searchable Markdown.
